fact: The Deputy Minister in the Presidency says Census 2022 was conducted during the pandemic and 62 million South Africans were counted; the speech gives no enumeration date beyond the year.

Statistics South Africa released the Quarterly Labour Force Survey Q2 2026 (P0211, fieldwork April to June 2026), a household-based sample survey of about 30,000 dwellings, reporting an unemployment rate of 33.6%.

Statistics South Africa states Census 2022 was enumerated with reference night 2 February 2022 and provinces completing enumeration at different times between February and May 2022, counting 62,027,503 people.
